answer_1.quote: We propose a Movie Clip Narrating (MCN) task that aims to generate a plot-related paragraph description given a clip in Movie101-N... the high cost of narration generation greatly hinders the production of movies with AD and thus limits the opportunities for visually impaired users to experience movies.
answer_1.outputs: Narration paragraphs (audio description) for movie clips

answer_2.quote: We settle on a new metric Movie Narration Score (MNScore)... we investigate a wide range of objective metrics: (1) State-of-the-art video captioning metrics based on deep neural networks including CLIP-Score, BERTScore and EMScore... (2) Textual quality metrics including n-grams diversity (DIV) and causal language model perplexity (PPL); (3) F1 score of role name generation (RoleF1).

answer_4.quote: We randomly select 30 movie clips, each with 5 candidate narrations... we recruit 10 annotators to individually rank the candidates for each video in terms of accuracy, informativeness, and textual quality.
answer_4.guideline: Rank the candidate narrations for each video according to accuracy, informativeness, and textual quality.
